title: Special Events Permit Request
description: Use this service request to request a permit for any outdoor special event, commercial filming activity in the City of Dallas, Dallas Street seats, and commercial promoter registration. This includes parades, foot races, street festivals and State Fair of Texas Parking licenses. ** Not for permits issued for garage sales, neighborhood block parties, animals, Dallas Convention Center events or Fair Park events. ** The estimated response time for this service request is 2 business days. To complete an application Click Here

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for an outdoor event, filming activity, or commercial promoter registration permit.
actions.why: For a permit for an outdoor special event, commercial filming in Dallas, Dallas Street Seats, or commercial promoter registration, including a parade, foot race, street festival, political event, or State Fair of Texas parking license. The 311 request form asks the permit type and event items such as a tent under 400 square feet, street closure, merchandise or food sales, trailer, van, or temporary signs.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Special Events Permit Request" requests does not apply to garage sale, neighborhood block party, animal, Dallas Convention Center, or Fair Park permits, or to event locations outside the City of Dallas jurisdiction.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Special Events Permit Request"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "Special Events Permit Request"
